Recently, Mophie has launched four new external chargers for iPhone. They can easily slip into your pocket, come in two design options, feature built-in cables, and offer 5,000mAh or 10,000mAh capacities. They are by no means the smallest chargers on the market, but the pricing is quite attractive and worth considering.

Mophie's brand-new PowerStation Plus power banks are divided into Standard and Signature editions, each available in 5,000mAh and 10,000mAh capacity options.

The Standard and Signature editions share the same dimensions, but the Signature edition features a more premium finish and comes with braided cables.

All four versions have a built-in USB-C cable for charging your device in emergencies, but the cable is not retractable. The cable is located on the side of the power bank and can be pulled out when you need to charge.

The three lower-tier PowerStation Plus models come with one built-in cable, while the Signature 10K version has two braided cables. Combined with an additional USB-C port, you can charge up to three devices simultaneously.

As mentioned at the start, these power banks are definitely not the smallest on the market, but they aren't as bulky as many other brands either. This allows them to fit easily into a trouser pocket without being too obtrusive, without needing to be carried in a backpack. It also features an LED charging status indicator.

Each Mophie PowerStation Plus supports 20W output via the USB-C port. The same port can also be used to charge the power bank itself. The 5K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro approximately once, while the 10K version can fully charge an iPhone 17 Pro twice. Given recent power bank fire incidents, Mophie has also designed these products to comply with airline carry-on luggage regulations.

You can purchase the Mophie PowerStation Plus on Amazon, with the series priced from US$29.95 up to US$59.95.

  • PowerStation Plus 5K Standard Series – US$29.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Standard Series – US$39.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 5K Signature Series – US$39.95 on Amazon
  • PowerStation Plus 10K Signature Series – US$59.95 on Amazon
